items.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests
items.description: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.

items.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
items.description: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

items.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
items.description: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

items.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
items.description: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.

items.title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
items.description: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.

items.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
items.description: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.

items.title: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
items.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

items.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
items.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

items.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
items.description: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.

items.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
items.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

items.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
items.description: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.

items.title: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
items.description: The pontiff will give the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing in St Peter's Square on Sunday.
